## Context / Problem
plan_review_precheck runs the deterministic floor before the LLM passes, but only a P8 too-big block short-circuits; the code states "A P1/P5 DET block does NOT stop the LLM" (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py:208-215). A plan that fails the blocking clarity floor (P1) therefore pays the full four-pass LLM review it is guaranteed to fail.

## Approach
Widen the existing P8 short-circuit branch in plan_review_precheck (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py:216-239) from "P8 blocked" to "any DET gate produced a blocking finding", reusing the same partition_findings/finalize_verdict path so the BLOCK verdict carries the DET findings with coverage.llm_ran=False. No change is needed in src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py: its _degraded_plan_review_verdict outage path already passes ALL det_blocks (not just P8) into partition_findings, confirmed by reading that function. The existing workflow test test_p1_det_block_still_runs_llm_and_blocks (tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_workflow.py:448) asserts the OLD behavior and is inverted by this change: it will be rewritten to assert finder.calls == 0 and a BLOCK verdict with coverage.llm_ran False. Alternative rejected: adding a content check to claimability.py — that seam is deliberately status-only (no plan-content checks) and reusing it would blur the fast-fail contract.

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py, tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_workflow.py (invert test_p1_det_block_still_runs_llm_and_blocks), tests/unit/workflow/test_det_short_circuit.py (new).

## Testing
Unit with the workflow test fixtures: a plan with no `## Acceptance Criteria` checklist (P1 block) yields BLOCK with zero finder calls; a DET-passing plan runs the LLM passes exactly as before; the emitted verdict carries the DET blocking findings and standard remediation text.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Any DET-floor blocking finding yields a BLOCK verdict with coverage.llm_ran False and zero finder invocations (checked: rewritten test_p1_det_block_still_runs_llm_and_blocks plus new cases in tests/unit/workflow/test_det_short_circuit.py).
- [ ] DET-passing plans run the full LLM passes unchanged (checked: existing plan-review workflow tests pass unmodified apart from the one inverted test).
- [ ] The short-circuit verdict includes every DET blocking finding (checked: unit test asserts finding ids present).
